messages:
molly: quick sync — console needs reliable P50/P95/P99, TTFT, and tokens/sec per model+route for the new performance dashboard. current problem: runtime emits ttft and token_count but route labeling is inconsistent across services. can infra say what we can standardize?

samir: runtime team can emit `ttft_ms` (histogram) and `token_count` per request today. right now label is `route_id` (internal numeric), some proxies attach `route_name`. happy to add labels but worried about cardinality.

jorge: ingestion/telemetry perspective: we should canonicalize labels at ingest-time (router -> route_name, model, deployment). propose a small normalization layer that maps route_id -> route_name using the route registry. this avoids pushing label explosion upstream.

devex-ellen: console UX: we need both fine-grained (route+model) and rolled-up views (model across all routes). panels expect units: ms for TTFT, tokens/sec for throughput. also need P50/P95/P99 and a tokens/sec timeseries with 1m and 5m rollups.

samir: agree. example of current emission: `runtime_request_duration_ms_bucket{model=\"redwood-small\",route_id=\"42\",le=\"100\"} 12` and `runtime_request_tokens_total{model=\"redwood-small\",route_id=\"42\"} 420`. propose adding `route_name` and `deployment` labels:

samir: ```
# proposed lines
runtime_request_duration_ms_bucket{model=\"redwood-small\",route_name=\"chat.send\",deployment=\"canary\",le=\"100\"} 12
runtime_request_tokens_total{model=\"redwood-small\",route_name=\"chat.send\",deployment=\"canary\"} 420
# and an emitted gauge for concurrent tokens/sec sample
runtime_tokens_per_sec{model=\"redwood-small\",route_name=\"chat.send\",deployment=\"canary\"} 85.2
```

jorge: that looks good. ingestion should also emit normalized tags like `team_owner` and `route_tier` (prod/beta) for dashboard filters. we can add a sampling flag `sample_rate` for very high-cardinality routes.

sre-kate: cardinality caution: if teams start adding freeform `route_alias` we get explosion. recommend a denylist for free labels, enforce max label values per metric, and create an aggregated metric for console (e.g., `route_request_duration_ms_sum` / `_count`) to compute percentiles server-side for long-term retention.

molly: UX question on rollouts: can we show fallback model latency when routing kicks to fallback? need a `routing_decision` label or a boolean `fallback=true` emitted on those requests so panels can join on decision.

samir: implementable. we can add `routing_path` and `fallback_model` labels when the router chooses a fallback. downside: these labels only appear on fallback samples. alternative is an event log you join by request_id. Which is better for console joins?

devex-ellen: event logs are fine but joining at query-time is expensive for interactive dashboards. labeled metrics are preferred for simple filtering. if we must, ingestion can backfill a metric `fallback_latency_ms` whenever fallback occurs.

jorge: ingestion plan: normalize labels, emit a derived metric `tokens_per_sec` computed from `tokens_total` delta per minute, and store 1m/5m rollups. this gives the console stable series without high cardinality real-time work.

samir: small API change on runtime side — adding `route_name`, `deployment`, `fallback_model`, and `routing_path` labels. backward compatible: existing metrics still emitted. will open a schema PR and a short migration note.

telemetry-bot: metric-emitter-service v1.7 deployed to staging (includes label-shim + config for normalized route names).

sre-kate: also propose quotas: put a soft quota on custom label values per team and a hard limit on unique label values per metric. slack notifications to owners when a route exceeds thresholds.

molly: next steps: samir to open runtime schema PR, jorge to draft ingestion normalization config, devex-ellen to sketch dashboard panels (P50/P95/P99 + tokens/sec rollups) and sample queries, sre-kate to write cardinality guardrail proposal. can we aim for a snapshot for the weekly eng sync on Thu?

samir: I'll get the PR up by EOD Wed.

jorge: I'll have a draft normalized mapping and rollup spec by Wed noon.

devex-ellen: mock panels by Wed afternoon. will include example PromQL and Grafana panel settings.

sre-kate: will draft quota text and alert thresholds by Wed EOD.

molly: perfect. thanks everyone :thumbsup: — we'll review at Thu eng sync.
